name: agent-doctor
description: Local-first evidence, context memory, cost visibility, and task diagnosis for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose coding tasks with sanitized local evidence.
interface.longDescription: Inspect bounded task evidence, retrieve transparent context capsules, and review available cost or quota signals without uploading prompts or source code.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-doctor to diagnose my latest task.
Use $agent-doctor to build a context capsule.
Use $agent-doctor to show available cost evidence.
